```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(rstatix)

mpa_design <- data %>% 
  select(climate_effect, mpa_effect, mpa_design) %>% 
  filter(!mpa_design == "global") #drop global occurrences from this analysis

#create contingency table
c_tbl <- mpa_design %>% 
  count(mpa_design, mpa_effect) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = mpa_effect, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("mpa_design") %>% 
  as.matrix()

#create contingency table
tbl <- mpa_design %>% 
  count(mpa_effect, mpa_design) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = mpa_design, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("mpa_effect") %>% 
  as.matrix()

chisq_result <- rstatix::chisq_test(c_tbl)
chisq_result2 <- chisq.test(tbl)

fisher_result <- rstatix::fisher_test(tbl)
pairs <- t(tbl) %>% pairwise_fisher_test()
std_resid <- chisq_result2$stdres


#print plot by proportion
figure_7 <- ggplot(data = mpa_design, aes(x = mpa_design, fill = mpa_effect)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") + #plot proportions, not counts
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of MPA effects per design category",
    fill = "MPA effect"
  ) +
  my_theme() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mpa_colors,
                    labels = c("No detected effect", "Ecosystem (+)", "Population (+)", "Ecosystem (-)", "Population (-)"))

ggsave(here("fig", "figure7.png"), plot = figure_7, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```
